description: Use the Cardputer Zero as a USB flash drive for laptops and phones

store.summary: Share a folder over USB-C as a flash drive for laptops and phones
store.description: Pick any folder on the Cardputer Zero and plug the right USB-C port into a laptop or Android phone: it shows up as a normal USB drive (exFAT or FAT32). Eject it on the computer and every change is saved back into the folder, owned by your user, so the files are ready to use on the Cardputer. Needs the USB switch in Slave position and your sudo password. Hidden files are always kept private, and files changed on the Cardputer are never overwritten.
